data.description: A prestigious residential development by Majid Al Futtaim, offering an exclusive collection of Mansions and Grand Villas.

data.answer: The community is equipped with world-class amenities, including outdoor gyms, yoga decks, swimming pools, jogging tracks, BBQ areas, and children's play areas, promoting a balanced and active lifestyle. Additionally, the development is strategically located along Dubai–Al Ain Road, offering seamless connectivity to key destinations such as Al Maktoum International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai Marina.

The Alaya Beach Villas in the prestigious Tilal Al Ghaf beachfront community redefine luxury living with their expansive 5 and 6-bedroom residences, spanning from 9,522 sq. ft. to 14,670 sq. ft. Buyers have the option to select from two distinct architectural styles: The Mediterranean, characterized by light tones and natural textures, or The Modernist, featuring darker, sleek finishes.

Each villa offers personalized interiors with two finishing options, Terra or Tundra, allowing residents to tailor their homes to their tastes.

Elegant Mansions and Grand Villas

Alaya Beach Dubai offers an exclusive collection of Mansions with three floors plus a basement. These residences are thoughtfully designed with:

  • Private elevators for seamless access
  • Spacious staff quarters and a laundry room
  • A basement level featuring a parking area, storage, a driver’s room, and an entertainment zone with an underwater window

On the ground level, each villa boasts a private pool, surrounded by lush landscaping, merging indoor and outdoor spaces. The open-plan design includes a fitted kitchen, guest suite, and a cozy family room.

Upper floors are reserved for the master suites, junior suites, and family areas, complete with walk-in closets and expansive terraces. The highlight is the rooftop terrace, perfect for stargazing or sunset gatherings.

The Reserve Grand Villas

These grand residences come in two distinct layouts with a G+2 structure. The villas feature:

  • Double-height entrances and floor-to-ceiling windows for ample natural light
  • State-of-the-art European kitchens
  • Ground level with a spacious living room, outdoor majlis, and guest bedroom
  • Upper floors with junior suites, a master suite with dedicated dressing rooms, and a family study area
  • A rooftop terrace with panoramic views, perfect for entertaining
  • Zen Suites for Wellness and Leisure

Alaya Beach Villas also offer unique Zen Suites, designed to enhance well-being and relaxation. Residents can choose from:

  • Heal: A tranquil yoga or meditation space
  • Exercise: A private workout zone
  • Entertain: An inviting area for social gatherings
  • Work: A serene home office with calming views

Additional features include spiraling staircases, spacious gardens with upgrade options, and sustainable cooling solutions to enhance comfort and energy efficiency.

Buying a Property in Alaya Beach

The Alaya Beach villas offer luxurious 5 and 6-bedroom layouts, with prices for the 6-bedroom residences averaging around AED 22M. These exclusive homes present ideal Alaya Beach investment opportunities for those seeking both a premium lifestyle and a strategic property investment in Dubai's thriving real estate market.

Majid Al Futtaim has introduced an attractive payment plan to cater to investors and end-users alike. Buyers can secure their property with a 10% down payment, followed by 50% in easy installments during the construction phase. The remaining 40% is payable upon handover, providing a flexible approach to owning a residence in this prestigious community. This payment structure, combined with the prime location and upscale amenities, makes Alaya Beach a compelling choice for those looking to invest in Dubai’s luxury property sector.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Alaya Beach?

data.answer:
The community is under the developmental phase but once completed it promises a beachfront lifestyle like none other. Here’s a look at what the residents can expect from their life in Alaya Beach.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Alaya Beach

Transportation options for Alaya Beach in Tilal Al Ghaf are still evolving as the area develops. For now, residents can easily access public transport in neighboring communities. Buses F37 and F38 are available just an 8-minute drive away at Dubai Sports City. 

Those preferring the Dubai Metro can reach the Jumeirah Golf Estates station on the Red Line in about 18 minutes. Each of the Alaya Beach Villas comes with dedicated parking spaces, ensuring convenience for homeowners.

Supermarkets Around Alaya Beach

For daily shopping needs, Carrefour within the Tilal Al Ghaf beachfront community provides easy access to essentials. Additional supermarket options like Al Maya and Spinneys are a short drive away, catering to a variety of grocery requirements.

Shopping Mall Near Alaya Beach

Once completed, the wider Tilal Al Ghaf development will include Distrikt, a retail hub featuring boutiques, dining outlets, and more, adding to the allure of Tilal Al Ghaf luxury properties.

Schools in and Near Alaya Beach

Families residing in Alaya Beach waterfront villas will benefit from the nearby Royal Grammar School Guildford Dubai, ensuring quality education within the community.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Alaya Beach

For spiritual needs, the area will include a mosque, with other options like Sports City Mosque and Al Rahman Mosque reachable within a 10-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Alaya Beach

Medical facilities are conveniently accessible, with Apex Medical and Dental Clinics as well as Mediclinic Me’aisem located within 15 minutes. For more comprehensive healthcare services, NMC Royal Hospital DIP, one of the region’s top multi-specialty hospitals, is just 16 minutes away. 

These factors contribute to the appeal of Alaya Beach investment opportunities in the growing Tilal Al Ghaf real estate market.

Location & Nearby Areas

Alaya Beach is conveniently located just a 5 to 10-minute drive from Motor City and Dubai Sports City, offering easy access to vibrant sports facilities and entertainment venues.

For those seeking closer proximity, Harmony Villas are only a short walk away, making the sub-community an ideal location for those looking for both convenience and luxury in the heart of Tilal Al Ghaf.

more_info.question: FAQs About Alaya Beach in Tilal Al Ghaf, Dubai

data.answer:
What types of properties are available at Alaya Beach in Tilal Al Ghaf?

Alaya Beach offers luxurious 5 and 6-bedroom villas, available in Mediterranean and Modernist styles, with customizable interiors and layouts to suit residents' preferences.

What amenities are included in Alaya Beach Villas?

Residents enjoy access to private pools, lush landscaped gardens, dedicated parking, and spacious rooftop terraces. The community also features easy access to the Lagoon Al Ghaf for watersports and recreational activities.

Is Alaya Beach a good investment opportunity?

Yes, Alaya Beach presents a strong investment opportunity due to its prime location, high-end amenities, flexible payment plans, and anticipated capital appreciation in the thriving Tilal Al Ghaf real estate market.

How close is Alaya Beach to key attractions and facilities in Dubai?

Alaya Beach is ideally located with Dubai International Stadium and Trump International Golf Club just a 10-minute drive away, ensuring residents have access to premier sports and leisure destinations.

When is the expected handover date for the Alaya Beach villas?

The Alaya Beach community is currently under development, with handovers scheduled for Q4, 2024, providing buyers with ample time to plan their move into this luxurious waterfront community.

Residents of Alaya Beach will enjoy a host of premium amenities and seamless access to shared facilities within the Tilal Al Ghaf master plan. Handovers are scheduled for Q4, 2024, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a luxurious yet customizable living experience.
